newsitem.title: USA: Grand Casinos higher as chairman ups stake.
newsitem.headline: Grand Casinos higher as chairman ups stake.

text.p: Grand Casinos Inc shares climbed nine percent in unusually heavy trade Thursday after Grand's chairman raised his already-large stake in the company by 300,000 shares.
At midsession New York Stock Exchange trade, Grand shares were up one to 12, easing off an intraday high of 12-1/2, a level last reached January 23.
Trading volume was heavy at more than 500,000 shares.
"(Chairman) Lyle Berman bought 300,000 shares in the company and the investment community is encouraged by that purchase," said Jason Ader, Bear Stearns gaming analyst.
A Grand spokeswomen said Berman, also the company chief executive, purchased the 300,000 shares for between 10-3/8 and 10-1/2 in the open market over the past two weeks.
The new purchases lift Berman's stake in Grand to about 4.6 million shares, or "a little over 10 percent," of the roughly 42 million shares outstanding, the spokeswoman said.

Grand, based in Minneapolis, operates casinos on the Mississippi Gulf Coast, manages land-based Native American-owned casinos in Minnesota and Louisiana, and is the owner of about 50 percent of Stratosphere Corp, a casino complex in Las Vegas which declared bankruptcy in January 1997, according to Bear Stearns' Global Gaming Almanac.
